propositions: Pandoc subprocess invocations hang indefinitely on pathological input because pypandoc sets no timeout and subprocess.run(timeout=) reaps only the direct child, not CPU-spinning grandchildren.

The renderer must spawn pandoc via its own Popen(start_new_session=True) with caller-side communicate(timeout=) and reap via rebar._proc.reap_process_group on TimeoutExpired to kill the whole process group.
Units that timeout or fail non-zero exit degrade to original Markdown without raising, maintaining per-unit fallback granularity and byte-identical output to the landed renderer.
The reconciler.dc_pandoc_timeout_s config key (default 10s) must be surfaced across schema, sources, golden test, and docs; CI must verify the pypandoc-binary wheel pin and NOTICE provenance.

Safe-run batching optimization is descoped; the spawn-tax reduction (12% vs 74% ceiling) is insufficient and causes ~12% of corpus bodies to render differently, which is unacceptable output divergence.
